csv_project_name: Consultant for Town's Comprehensive Community Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The selected consultant will prepare a full update of the Town of Hopkinton Comprehensive Community Plan. The update shall satisfy all Rhode Island statutory and Statewide Planning Program requirements for plan content and shall be suitable for submission to the State for certification. The Town is seeking a multidisciplinary team with demonstrated expertise across the full range of comprehensive plan elements, including land use, housing, transportation, economic development, and natural resource protection. The consultant is not required to follow the organizational structure or format of the current plan; the Town is open to a document structure that best serves clarity, usability, and State compliance.
csv_disciplines_requested: Housing & Urban Development, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
